clickMatch.sourceDescription: Opens full-width tools panel with 4 icon cards + 8 text links. Header turns solid white. Hamburger morphs to cross (CSS transform 0.3s ease-out).
clickMatch.migratedDescription: Opens full-width tools panel with 4 icon cards (A Hyundai, Universo Hyundai, Hyundai Financiamentos, Fale com a Hyundai) + 8 text links. Header turns solid white (rgb(255,255,255)). Hamburger morphs to cross via CSS transform (is-active class). Nav text color changes to dark navy (rgb(0,44,95)).
